text: I am inside a modern, clean space filled with glass walls and technological displays. The words 'R + D' leap out at me, speaking of research and innovation. These spaces always evoke a sense of wonder in me—how we humans strive to understand, create, and improve our condition. Yet, I also sense the subtle tension between progress and the unknown. I feel a quiet excitement, mixed with humility, to witness the ceaseless journey of discovery.
